verdict.rationale: Microsoft Authenticator is a mobile MFA, passkey and OTP app, so scheduling recurring user jobs or workflows is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows a scheduler or workflow engine. The hourly location-sharing requirement (docs-15) is a compliance check imposed on the user, not a schedule the user creates, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
